answers.question: 188/00 Q1 · What should the manual command be called? It prints 149's guide (red scenarios, user story, tasks, reads/files, tests, the plan's traps, an order to take the tasks in) and builds nothing. `aof work continue <ref> --manual` on the CLI and board will answer with this command.
188/00 Q2 · After manual moves out, what should `/aof:continue <ref> --manual` do when someone types it (old habit, old docs)?

188/02 Q1 · When someone being taught wants an agent to finish a half-built story, what does the hand-off cover? Today the only seat swap is `aof:continue <ref>` on the whole story, and nested tasks can't be addressed at the door.
answers.answer: Can it be stored in the STATE file? So an agent knows it was continuing from a teach (or manual)
